newsitem.title: BELGIUM: West Europe Oct air passenger traffic up 7.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: West Europe Oct air passenger traffic up 7.1 pct.

text.p: Weat European air passenger traffic rose by 7.1 percent in October, compared with the year-ago period, the Association of European Airlines said on Monday.
"The growth was fuelled, as in previous months, by strong increases on African and South American routes," it said in a statement.
Passenger traffic on the key North Atlantic route rose by 6.6 percent, from last year.
The association added that 73.1 percent of passenger seats were sold in October, identical to the year-ago period.
"The growth rate for the whole of this year points to a final 1996 result of between plus 7.0 percent and 7.5 percent, closely matched to capacity," the AEA's editor said in the statement.
He said the market was fully absorbing the increase in capacity.
Freight traffic rose 4.2 percent in October, from a year-ago. A 2.9 percent fall on the North Atlantic route was outweighed by an 8.2 percent increase in Far East traffic.
